title: Attention is Needed for RF Fingerprinting

dataset.name: USRP OFDM
dataset.data_volume: 200 transmissions (10 x 100 transmissions per location) yielding 171,454 segmented samples (87,594 in Subset 1 and 83,860 in Subset 2)
dataset.participants_devices: 10 USRP X310 SDRs used as transmitters and 1 USRP X310 SDR used as receiver
dataset.experimental_conditions: Sampling rate of 5 M/s; IEEE 802.11a baseband signals generated using gr-IEEE802-11 based on GNURadio; receiver fixed at left-bottom corner, transmitter placed at location A or B to simulate different channel states; Gaussian white noise with random intensity (SNR between 0 and 30 dB) added to training samples

accuracy.experimental_condition: Hybrid training mode with Gaussian white noise added in training stage
accuracy.evaluation_setting: Tested on USRP OFDM dataset (40% test set)

limitation: The CNNs designed in the experiment have a fixed limit on the length of the input signal segments.

dataset.text: 10 USRP X310 SDRs are used as transmitters and 1 USRP X310 SDR is used as receiver to sample IQ data... Finally, we collect 100 transmissions from each transmitter. Table 2 gives more details of the collected USRP OFDM dataset

accuracy.text: DAConv-ResNet50 which combined ResNet50 and our Dual Attention Convolution module can achieve 95.6% recognition accuracy on 10 USRP X310.

limitation.text: At present, the CNNs designed in our experiment have a fixed limit on the length of the input signal segments.
